source.authorityName: School examination paper (school not named); obtained from icseboard.org, originally from icseonline.com
source.notes: Scanned school paper with no text layer (only the icseboard.org watermark); OCR corrected against the page images. No school name is printed. Printed header: GRADE VIII, TIME - 2 HOURS, ASSESSMENT II, BIOLOGY, M.M. 80. No year is printed on the paper; examYear 2024 is taken from the file name (...-290224-2024) and the icseboard.org folder. Section A (40 marks) is compulsory; its six groups (I-VI) print only a group total ([10], [6] x5), so each group is kept as one entry with that total (never split). Section B (40 marks) has six questions of 10 marks each (sub-parts printed [3]/[3]/[4]) of which any five are to be attempted, so the listed marks add up to 100, not 80. The first sub-part on page 3 under VII is printed as 'b)' (the label is partly damaged on the scan) and is stored as VII (b). The paper's own spellings (e.g. 'hoistein', 'cordination', 'venacava', option labels 'c) Infancy'/'c) Embryo') are kept. The Whatsapp advertisement on page 3 and the icseboard.org watermark are ignored. No answer key is printed.
source.usage: School examination paper published on icseboard.org (originally icseonline.com); question text reproduced for study with attribution and a link to where it was obtained. Figures are not reproduced.

questions.text:
Choose the correct option.
1. Which one of the following is a growth phase in human beings.
a) Pupa b) Foetus c) Infancy c) Embryo
2. Tissue fluid is
a) Intracellular fluid b) Extracellular fluid c) Lymph d) Plasma
3. Reflex actions are under the control of
a) Brain b) Spinal Cord c) Medulla d) Spinal Cord and Medulla
4. Which of the following disease occur in dirty areas?
a) Malaria b) Rabies c) AIDS d) Anaemia
5. The Silver Revolution refers to increase production of
a) Fish b) Egg c) Milk d) Rice
6. The exotic breed of poultry
a) Assel b) White leghorn c) Large White Yorkshire d) Bikaneri
7. The first vaccine was produced by
a) Jenner b) Robert hook c) A. Fleming d) Pasteur
8. The number of Cranial nerves in man is
a) Twelve Pairs b) Ten Pairs c) Thirty one Pairs d) Twenty Four Pairs
9. Which one is not correct about veins?
a) Veins are thick-walled b) Veins have valves to maintain unidirectional flow c) Veins are collecting vessels d) Blood in veins flows towards heart
10. Increased secretion of Thyroxine hormone causes
a) Increased heartbeat b) Simple goitre c) General sluggishness d) Overgrowth of body
